A tiny todo list for your terminal

Usage: todo-cli <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Add a new task
  list    Show all tasks
  done    Mark a task as done
  remove  Delete a task
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
